rules: One task per session. Split before implementation if one observable contract cannot fit a small change.

tasks.title: Use an absolute deadline for a network round trip
tasks.deliverable: A shared remaining-time contract for request write, header/body read and partial-frame progress.

evidence.results: BrokerConn::roundtrip shares one absolute deadline across write and read. A peer that delays both cannot consume two full budgets. limits: Producer::fire still calls write_all_timeout and read_response separately, so that path can still spend two request_timeout budgets. Callers of BrokerConn::roundtrip, including consumer fetch and coordinator RPCs, share one deadline.
